name: MEVBOTa47b
report: The root cause is insufficient validation in the receiveFlashLoan function. The attacker can input arbitrary data combined in userData. This vulnerability was exploited in the MEV bot (0x00000000000a47b1298f18cf67de547bbe0d72), resulting in a loss of approximately 187.75 WETH.
report_zh: 根本原因是 receiveFlashLoan 函数验证不足。攻击者可以在 userData 中组合任意数据。此漏洞在 MEV 机器人（0x00000000000a47b1298f18cf67de547bbe0d72）中被利用，导致损失约 187.75 WETH。
